title: Rakhshani dialect
extract: Rakhshani, also referred to as Western Balochi, is a Balochi dialect. The dialect has several important subdialects and spoken predominantly in Pakistan, Iran, Afghanistan and Turkmenistan. The Ethnologue database has classified the dialect under the western Balochi.
